subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
specific_objectives: 15.1.11.2 Trainee will be able to explain operation of fatigue meter.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstrate fatigue meter operation on simulator; observe safety precautions regarding electrical isolation; instructor supervises trainee interaction with controls.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a fatigue meter in an aircraft?
How does the fatigue meter relate to the overall electrical power generation system?
Why is monitoring fatigue critical for flight safety?

development.content:
Principle of fatigue meter operation
Input signal acquisition from generators
Signal processing and integration logic
Display unit calibration and readout
Alarm threshold settings and indications

Step-by-step operational procedure
Interpretation of meter readings
Troubleshooting common display faults
Maintenance checks and calibration steps
Recording data for flight logs

topics: Impact of fatigue on power generation
Limitations of the fatigue meter system
development.content:
Impact of fatigue on power generation
Correlation with other electrical parameters
Limitations of the fatigue meter system
Integration with central warning systems
Future trends in fatigue monitoring

summary_questions: Explain the sequence of events when a fatigue threshold is exceeded.
Describe how the fatigue meter data assists in maintenance scheduling.
Identify two potential causes for inaccurate fatigue meter readings.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the fatigue meter operation principles with the parameter selection methods for flight data recorders covered in LP 30.

pft_rows.syllabus: Flight data recorders, parameters selected methods of recording.
